item.title: Helen Dennis, Successful Aging: New doctor search can bring good partnership
item.description: Choosing a physician is key, particularly in later life when we often are confronted with more conditions and diseases. In addition to physician competency, one of the most important aspects of getting good health care is the patient-doctor relationship. And that relationship has changed.

item.title: SF Giants manager Vitello clarifies timeline of his hire — four months after leaving Tennessee
item.description: Tony Vitello officially became the Giants' 40th manager on October 22nd

item.title: Trying to tame the Olympic controversy, World Curling sent in the umps. Then it sent them away
item.description: Curlers say they take pride in officiating themselves.

item.title: Federal cuts could shutter farm to food bank program
item.description: The Local Food Purchase Assistance Program, known in California as Farms Together, pays farmers fair market prices to supply fresh foods directly to local food banks. Since the program launched in January 2024, it has supported 800 farms statewide and fed more than 2 million Californians.

item.title: Gonzales man arrested for murdering his wife after reporting emergency
item.description: Pablo Villasenor, 66, told emergency dispatchers that his wife was bleeding and that he did not know how it happened. Sheriff’s deputies responding to the call found 60 year-old Carmen Vega Tapia with severe lacerations.

item.title: TAMC awarded $13M in funding for Marina, Salinas, Seaside programs
item.description: “These awards demonstrate what we can accomplish when local communities, schools, and regional partners work together, and when we use Measure X to show the state that Monterey County is ready to deliver transformative, people-centered transportation projects,” said TAMC Executive Director Todd Muck in a press release.

item.title: Kurtenbach: Does SF Giants manager Tony Vitello actually want to be here?
item.description: The Giants manager's strange Monday presser opened up big questions that shouldn't be asked in spring training.

item.title: Rainy weather forecast for the entire week in Monterey County
item.description: “We are getting this weather coming down from the Gulf of Alaska,” said Ryan Walbrun, meteorologist with the National Weather Service Bay Area headquartered in Monterey. “So it’s a much colder system and won’t have as much moisture as the storms we saw over the Christmas holiday.”

item.title: Trump administration ordered to restore George Washington slavery exhibit it removed in Philadelphia
item.description: The order came on Presidents Day, the federal holiday honoring Washington’s legacy.
